While the paper describes many other pharmacological perturbations (Bortezomib, CB-5083, etc.) and genetic knockouts (TAX1BP1, DNAJB6), these were primarily validated via immunoblotting and microscopy; only the TurboID-based proximity labeling experiments were analyzed by mass spectrometry.
